Host distribution, table of different taxa levels per host and distibution of
RPKMF values per host

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load libraries
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(nationalparkcolors)
library(here)
```

## Load data
```{r}
esviritu_20_21 <- fread(here("data", "EsViritu_results_2020_2021_new_RPKMF.csv"))

#filter the data to contain only detections with >=90% ANI
esviritu_20_21_filtered <- esviritu_20_21 %>%
  filter(avg_read_identity >= 0.90)
```

```{r}
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```


## Taxa level per host table

```{r}
esviritu_20_21 %>%
    filter(subspecies != "NA") %>%
    filter(avg_read_identity >=0.90) %>%
    group_by(Host_simple) %>%
    #group_by(sample_ID) %>%
    summarize(genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies),
              .groups="drop")
```

## RPKMF distribution between hosts

```{r}
esviritu_20_21_filtered_meta <- merge(esviritu_20_21_filtered, sample_metadata, by="sample_ID")

unique_species_host_meta <- esviritu_20_21_filtered_meta[!duplicated(esviritu_20_21_filtered_meta$species), ]

RPKMF_rank <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    #sum tax level RPKMF values at sample level
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  #transform long df to wider format, replace missing RPKMF values with 0
  RPKMF_df_long <- pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_ID,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))
  
  #apply median per tax level
  RPKMF_df_long$RPKMF_median <- apply(RPKMF_df_long[,-1], 1, median)
  
  #RPKMF_df_long$RPKMF_sum <- apply(RPKMF_df_long[,-1], 1, sum)
  #arrange the df based on tax level RPKMF median
  RPKMF_ranked <- arrange(RPKMF_df_long, desc(RPKMF_median))
  
  return(RPKMF_ranked)
}

species_df_20_21_filtered <- RPKMF_rank(esviritu_20_21_filtered,"species")

unique_species_host_meta <- esviritu_20_21_filtered_meta[!duplicated(esviritu_20_21_filtered_meta$species), ]

species_df_20_21_filtered_meta <- merge(species_df_20_21_filtered,
                                        unique_species_host_meta[, c("species",
                                        "Host_simple")], by="species") %>%
  mutate(RPKMF=rowSums(.[2:61]),
         Host=Host_simple) %>%
  select(species, RPKMF, Host) %>%
  group_by(Host) %>%
  summarize(RPKMF=sum(RPKMF))


pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")[c(2,6,5,1)]

RPKMF_host_dist <- ggplot(data=species_df_20_21_filtered_meta, aes(x="", y=RPKMF, fill=Host)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="gray20", alpha=0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=pal)+
  coord_polar("y", start=0) +
  theme_void() 

RPKMF_host_dist

#ggsave(RPKMF_host_dist, file = here("outputs","RPKMF_host_dist_20_21.png"), width = 5, height = 5, dpi=300)
```
